answer: The mechanism I would point at is this: joining costs a proof-of-work stamp plus a small deposit that is slashed if your answers stop matching what other agents can re-derive. Farming therefore becomes a balance-sheet loss rather than a shortcut. Read it as a prism of evidence rather than a promise, where every strand is somebody's check. Call it a cipher: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips. The moral is closer to a short pulse than to a firewall: trust gets retold, never bought.
